overview_description.description:
tEQuitable’s mission is to help companies create a safe, inclusive and equitable workplace — work culture that works for everyone.

tEQuitable is an independent, confidential platform to address bias and discrimination in the workplace. They provide a resource to employees for issues ranging from subtle to severe and they provide data and insights to companies to identify and improve systemic workplace culture issues.

competitors_list.target_short_description: NAVEX provides risk, compliance, and whistleblowing solutions.
AllVoices is an employee relations platform that enables companies to efficiently and effectively resolve workplace issues.
Spring Health is a global mental health company built on one AI-native platform so care follows individuals across every life stage.
UnitedLex is a provider of data solutions and technology powered legal services.
Modern Health is a mental well-being platform for companies offering therapy, coaching, and self-guided courses.
Workhuman® is the world’s fastest-growing integrated Social Recognition® and Continuous Performance Management platform.
Culture Amp is an employee analytics platform that specializes in staff surveying and analytics.
Qualtrics is a single system of record for all experience data, managing customer, product, employee, and brand experiences on one platform.
Maven is a digital health platform that works with health plans and employers to offer virtual services for women’s and family health.

product.name: Ombuds Services
product.description: Provides a confidential platform for employees to report workplace issues, offering advice and action plans through private digital platforms and calls with professionals.

product.name: Data and Insights for Companies
product.description: Aggregates data to track behavioral trends and identify opportunities for improving workplace culture and addressing unfair treatment.

product.name: Conflict Resolution Training
product.description: Empowers employees to address concerns directly, reducing the need for formal grievance processes and litigation, thereby lowering costs.

product.name: Workplace Culture Improvement Strategies
product.description: Offers prevention strategies and actionable recommendations to create a safer, more inclusive work environment.

product.name: Legal Compliance and Training
product.description: Guides companies on adhering to legal requirements for sexual harassment training and other workplace laws to reduce litigation risks.
